Medevac helicopters were spotted evacuating casualties after unexploded ordnance detonated during a field trip by a group of students and teachers to the Ramim Ridge near the Lebanon border.
According to preliminary reports, 12 people were injured. One is in critical condition, three are seriously injured, and one sustained moderate injuries.
The remaining casualties suffered minor injuries.
An Iranian Shahed-136 loitering munition struck a camp belonging to the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) in Koya, Erbil Governorate, Iraqi Kurdistan.

A Pakistan Army Aviation MFI-17 Mushshak training aircraft crashed near Nawakilli in Balochistan Province due to a technical malfunction.
Both pilots on board, Major Husnain Shehzad Humayun, an instructor pilot, and Captain Abdul Samad, a student pilot, were killed in the crash.
Ukraine’s Defence Intelligence (HUR) reports that Russia is developing a new variant of the Kh-47M2 Kinzhal aeroballistic missile equipped with a high-explosive fragmentation warhead.
Ansar Allah (Houthis) forces have captured Al-Misrakh District, the last major populated area in the direction of Taiz.

Ansar Allah (Houthis) has released footage showing its forces repelling an attempted advance by the Southern Giants Brigades and Nation’s Shield Forces from Lahij Governorate toward the highlands of Al-Wazi’iyah District in Taiz Governorate.
The footage also shows Ansar Allah forces clearing Wadi Sharirah and the surrounding mountains toward Al-Shamayatayn District.

Denmark and Italy push forward on migration control.
The EU Parliament has voted to back new rules for return hubs outside Europe. This allows faster returns of rejected asylum seekers and irregular migrants to third countries, speeding up deportations and strengthening border management.
Led by efforts from Denmark’s Mette Frederiksen and Italy’s Giorgia Meloni, Europe is moving toward more pragmatic, effective migration policies.
